name: io.github.I4cTime/q-ring
title: q-ring
description: Quantum-inspired keyring for AI coding agents with superposition, entanglement, and tunneling.

environmentVariables.name: QRING_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Secret storage backend. Defaults to the OS keychain; set to "file" for headless hosts with no Secret Service (CI, containers).

environmentVariables.name: QRING_FILE_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Passphrase for the encrypted file backend (AES-256-GCM). Required only when QRING_BACKEND=file — without it the file backend fails closed.

environmentVariables.name: QRING_FILE_BACKEND_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Custom path for the encrypted file store (default: ~/.config/q-ring/file-backend.enc).
